question: Should the experimental Claw package contract make `CLAW.md` the canonical export and authoring format while retaining JSON input compatibility?
rationale: Choosing the generated artifact and canonical serialization is a durable public CLI/package contract, not merely an internal parser implementation detail, and neither the open RFC nor the stacked base establishes confirmed maintainer direction.

options.title: Adopt CLAW.md Canonically
options.body: Approve `CLAW.md` as the exported human-readable manifest, retain desired JSON input compatibility, and fix the parser boundary before landing.

options.title: Keep JSON Export
options.body: Accept `CLAW.md` as optional input while continuing to generate `openclaw.claw.json` until the wider specification is settled.

options.title: Defer Format Support
options.body: Pause this slice until the RFC and underlying Claw lifecycle stack establish the permanent package contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt CLAW.md Canonically
recommendation.body: Approve `CLAW.md` as the exported human-readable manifest, retain desired JSON input compatibility, and fix the parser boundary before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-level product and public package-format decision rather than a mechanical parsing choice.
